author: Ingolf Lohmann
binding_rule: Each source supports only the listed claim scope and never overrides the listed boundary.

primary_sources.boundary: Does not establish physical realizability of every process matrix, QIK-VRT, spacetime emergence or backwards signalling.
Does not establish time travel, physical retrocausality or a spacetime derivation.
Causal-witness theory is conditional on its stated process assumptions and does not by itself certify a natural implementation.
Does not establish a causal-inequality violation, superluminal communication or backwards signalling.
A causal-set proposal is not an empirical proof that nature is a causal set or a complete derivation of general relativity.
The reconstruction assumptions matter; an arbitrary relation graph is not thereby a spacetime and scale or dynamics are not supplied.
Nonclassical causal correlations do not establish a physical signal sent backwards in time.
Certification remains tied to the protocol and assumptions stated in the paper and is not empirical confirmation of QIK-VRT.

formal_binding.boundary: Kernel acceptance proves only the exact formal statements under their definitions, imports and disclosed axiom dependencies.

normative_binding.boundary: Repository provenance can bind authorship and wording but cannot turn a value judgement into a theorem of nature.
